attributes.cardDescription: Compute a completion set's owned/target counts and percentage from the current collection, without storing the result.
attributes.readMe:
## Calculate Completion

The spec's `CalculateCompletion` tool. Wraps `completion-set.gts`'s exported pure function `computeCompletion` — the app, this command, and any future consumer all call the same implementation, so there is exactly one definition of "80% complete" in the realm.

### No matrix concept existed

Confirmed absent from all 590 tracker rows — a pure new command.

### Example

`linkedExamples` points at the command's natural target: `CompletionSet/travis-scott-nike`.

### Read-only by design

`CompletionSet` deliberately stores no `progress` field (see its own header note: the numerator is a rollup over `CollectionItem`s and storing it guarantees drift the moment a pair is bought or sold). This command computes and returns the number; it never patches the set.
